summary: Iteration 28 — Frontend-only verification of the four iteration-28 follow-up features on top of iter-26/27. All 4 PASS end-to-end in headless Chromium via Playwright against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (https://dj-playout-studio.preview.emergentagent.com). (A) PAD LABELS + COLOUR: assigned the seeded WAV to [data-testid=jingle-pad-0] via click→[data-testid=jingle-file-input] set_input_files. [data-testid=jingle-edit-0] appeared, clicked it, [data-testid=jingle-edit-panel-0] opened. Typed 'Drop' into [data-testid=jingle-label-input-0] — pad button text updated live to '1Drop' (badge + label). Clicked [data-testid=jingle-color-0-cyan] — pad outer border style updated to rgb(46, 229, 196) which is the cyan swatch (#2ee5c4). [data-testid=jingle-edit-done-0] closed the panel. Flipped [data-testid=pad-page-next] → label '2/2', then [data-testid=pad-page-prev] → label '1/2'; the custom name 'Drop' and cyan border BOTH persisted on pad 0. No console errors. (B) STEM TO DECK: opened [data-testid=stem-isolator-modal] via [data-testid=open-stem-isolator]; selected the seeded testwav in [data-testid=stem-source-select] (buffer decoded), clicked [data-testid=stem-record-mix], waited ~2.2s, clicked again to stop. After ~4s the new [data-testid=stem-send-deck] button appeared in the transport. Clicked it — the Stem modal closed, [data-testid=standby-track-name] populated with 'testwav · Mix', [data-testid=standby-take] became enabled (disabled attribute removed), and a banner shows 'Armed "testwav · Mix" on the standby deck — hit TAKE (\\) for the drop.' No console errors. (C) PRESET SHARING: opened Voice Booth via [data-testid=record-voice-button] → [data-testid=voice-recorder-modal]; created 'MyPreset' by setting [data-testid=voice-pad-db]=6, toggling [data-testid=voice-comp-toggle] on, typing into [data-testid=voice-fx-preset-name] and clicking [data-testid=voice-fx-preset-save] → chip [data-testid=voice-fx-preset-MyPreset] appears. [data-testid=voice-fx-preset-export] is enabled (no disabled attr); clicking it triggered a real Playwright download event with suggested_filename='HotLive95 Voice FX Presets.json' (JSON). [data-testid=voice-fx-preset-import] and hidden [data-testid=voice-fx-preset-import-input] both exist. Set files on the hidden input with a valid preset JSON ([{name:'Imported',padDb:3,compOn:true,gateOn:false}]) → chip [data-testid=voice-fx-preset-Imported] appeared in the chip strip. (D) FULL-SCREEN INSTALL WELCOME: after a fresh unlock (localStorage cleared before both goto's), the full-screen overlay [data-testid=install-prompt] appeared with [data-testid=install-prompt-install], [data-testid=install-prompt-later] and [data-testid=install-prompt-dismiss]. In headless Chromium (no beforeinstallprompt), clicking [data-testid=install-prompt-install] revealed [data-testid=install-prompt-steps] containing [data-testid=install-prompt-steps-done]. Clicking Got it (which calls dismiss()) closed the overlay. After a full page reload the prompt did NOT reappear and localStorage['hotlive95_a2hs_dismissed'] === '1' as expected. Separately verified [data-testid=install-prompt-later] path in run 2 by clicking it — also dismisses correctly.

issues: Carry-over from iter 20-27: visual-editor injects <span x-dynamic> inside <option> elements in PlayerBar.js line ~396, producing React hydration warning 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Non-blocking but noisy. Only warnings observed in console; all other flows produce zero errors.

action_items: (Carry-over, low) Remove the visual-editor <span>-in-<option> injection in PlayerBar.js to clear the hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: JingleBar.js: onRename/onColor wiring is clean; label falls back to j.name (`j.label || j.name`) and color falls back to var(--hl-amber). Persistence works because label/color live on the jingles array in App state. Consider trimming label on save to avoid all-whitespace names.

JingleBar.js: [data-testid=jingle-label-input-${i}] updates onChange live (uncontrolled from a UX perspective — no explicit save button, only close). This is fine but the placeholder shows j.name so an empty input effectively falls back to filename — good UX.

StemIsolator.js: lastMix state is set in onstop and stem-send-deck fires onSendMixToDeck(lastMix.blob, lastMix.name). App.js sendMixToDeck creates a blob URL, adds a track, loads standby, closes the modal and sets a banner in one atomic flow — verified end-to-end.

VoiceRecorder.js: importFxPresets does JSON.parse inside try/catch and dedupes by name (Map). exportFxPresets Blob download works reliably (verified via Playwright download event). Chip testid uses raw name — the token 'Imported'/'MyPreset' worked; multi-word/special-char names would still need slugifying to avoid selector escaping issues (carry-over note from iter 27).

InstallPrompt.js: dismiss() writes localStorage 'hotlive95_a2hs_dismissed'='1' and both 'Maybe later' and 'Got it' correctly trigger it; the useEffect early-returns if the flag is set on mount, so reload behaviour matches the spec. isStandalone() short-circuit is correct. The 600ms delay is intentional and confirmed observable.
No regressions on iter-26/27 features (license gate, pad bank pages, FX preset save/apply, stem record + download).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Repro notes for iter-28 features: (1) Fresh install-prompt requires localStorage.clear() before goto twice — first goto establishes the origin, then clear + goto again so the flag isn't set on mount. (2) [data-testid=add-files-input] is hidden — always call set_input_files with state='attached' when waiting, or just skip the wait since Playwright allows uploading to hidden inputs directly. (3) Pad assignment requires clicking the empty pad first (which sets targetIndex.current) BEFORE set_input_files on jingle-file-input — otherwise the file is ignored. (4) For stem-send-deck to appear, the record→stop cycle needs ~4s for the WAV encoder to finish (bufferToWav in onstop) — waiting 3–4s post-stop is reliable. (5) Cyan swatch value is #2ee5c4 → rgb(46, 229, 196); other swatches: amber #ffab00, fire #ff5a1f, blue #3aa0ff, green #7CFF9B, pink #ff5a8a, violet #9b6bff, white #e5e5e5.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. First script iteration failed at seed (add-files-input wait_for_selector defaults to visible=true, but the input has class 'hidden') and consequently at Stem source select (no tracks). Fixed by using state='attached'. All 4 features PASS on rerun.
